description: GeoRisk Explorer is an Earth-observation and geospatial analytics project focused on environmental change in the Lower Piura basin, Peru. We use satellite and climate datasets to examine rainfall and land-surface trends, map historical flood extent, and explore spatial exposure. I bring Python, GIS, remote sensing, data analysis, and machine learning. I’m open to collaborators in Earth science/hydrology, statistics, web development, UX/design, and science communication.
